Window Tinting in Qatar: What to Know

Straight answers on heat, film types, installation, coverage and pricing — from the team that installs window film in Doha seven days a week.

01 45°C+Qatar summers

Why Window Film Matters in Qatar’s Heat

With summer temperatures above 45°C, untreated glass lets solar heat and UV rays pour into homes and offices. Rooms overheat, the AC works harder and furniture fades.

Heat rejection window film stops up to 98% of that heat at the glass and blocks 99% of UV — while keeping your daylight and your view.

See window films
02 Nano ceramicNo fading

Nano Ceramic vs Regular Tint

Regular dyed tint mainly darkens the glass. Nano ceramic film uses ceramic particles to reject infrared heat without heavy darkening, so rooms stay bright and cool.

Ceramic film does not interfere with phone or GPS signals, and it will not fade or turn purple over time.

Read the full comparison
